title: The Stock Exchange
description: Understand where and how stocks are bought and sold.

slides.title: The Marketplace
slides.content: A stock exchange is like a giant marketplace, but instead of fruits and vegetables, people buy and sell shares of companies.

slides.title: Major Exchanges
slides.content: Famous examples include the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) and NASDAQ in the US, or the National Stock Exchange (NSE) and Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) in India.

slides.title: How it Works
slides.content: When you want to buy a stock, your broker sends an order to the exchange. The exchange matches your buy order with someone else's sell order.

quiz.question: What is the main purpose of a stock exchange?

options.text: To set the prices of all products in the country
To match buyers and sellers of company shares
options.explanation: Correct! An exchange facilitates the trading of stocks between buyers and sellers.

options.text: To loan money to new businesses
options.explanation: That is what a bank does, not a stock exchange.
